final: WITH department_counts AS (SELECT major.department AS department, COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM member JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id GROUP BY major.department), total AS (SELECT SUM(member_count) AS total_count FROM department_counts), shares AS (SELECT department, member_count, CAST(member_count AS REAL) / total_count AS share FROM department_counts CROSS JOIN total WHERE total_count IS NOT NULL), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS value FROM shares) SELECT department, member_count, share, share - value FROM shares CROSS JOIN average_share WHERE value IS NOT NULL AND share > value
